First of all, I give thanks to my Blessed Mother and my Jesus.
I offer a thousand thanks for bringing me to this altar to share my testimony. My name is Radhika Rajan.
This is my husband, and this is his friend. Through the intercession of the Blessed Mother,
I have received many physical healings from Jesus. Along with that, I have had many other profound experiences.
I have come to this altar to share all of those blessings with you today.
To begin with, I come from a small village called Ilanjimel, in the Puliyoor Panchayat of Chengannur Taluk.
To tell you the truth, my sister-in-law used to share many YouTube testimonies of the Blessed Mother with my husband and me.
My sister-in-law is a nurse in Delhi, but at that time, I was a non-Christian.
Because of that, we never used to open or watch any of those videos back then.
We would immediately cancel and delete them as soon as they arrived.
We never opened any of those things, because I was a non-Christian who only believed in the local deity and only went to the temple.
That was my only belief system. One day, when I went to my parents' house, I saw a Kreupasanam newspaper lying on the settee in the hall.
I asked my mother where the paper came from.
My father said, "A sister nearby had a baby, and she brought it over."
I asked my mother, "Why are you keeping these things here?" I didn't tear the paper, but I crumpled it up and threw it away.
It was only about a month after doing that, that the realization of my grave mistake struck my mind.
Along with that, many sorrowful experiences began to unfold in my life. First of all,
I faced a minor issue with the Irrigation Department. My septic tank is located on the western side of my house.
Just beyond that is the irrigation canal. They claimed that our septic tank was encroaching upon the canal's property.
They came over, and it caused a huge problem.
I tried to intervene through the Panchayat, but I couldn't resolve it.
We were in an absolute dilemma, carrying an immense burden of sorrow.
We were entirely heartbroken. Then, one day, a friend of mine called me.
She told me that her daughter's illness was completely healed after she went to Kreupasanam.
She said, “You don’t need to believe, and you don’t even have to go there. Just submit a Light Candle Request to have some faith in it.”
She advised, "Just search for it on Google and pray. The Blessed Mother will hear it, and you will receive faith."
She added, "If so, you must give me your word; if your intention is fulfilled, you must go there and take the Pilgrim Covenant."
I agreed and said, "Alright, if this is granted to me, I will go there and take the Pilgrim Covenant."
Since I didn't know much about it, I lit a traditional lamp and gathered my children around.
Even then, I prayed to my local deity, saying, "Mother, my Vallakkavil Amma, I am going to do this for Mother Mary."
I prayed, "I don't know about this, please guide me." I typed 'Kreupasanam' into Google, and it appeared.
I prayed, "My Blessed Mother, please save me from this issue with the Irrigation Department."
With that intention, I submitted the request. I cried out and prayed fervently.
As I was drifting off to sleep that afternoon, someone came near me, tapped me, and told me to go see the Panchayat President again tomorrow.
I jumped up immediately. I quickly called my husband and told him to take a leave from work the next day.
I said, "We need to go to the Panchayat tomorrow." He replied, "Why? Haven't we already seen the President so many times?"
I insisted, "No, we must go tomorrow; someone told me we have to go."
The next day, he took a leave, and both of us went to see the President, who immediately called someone on the phone.
They said they needed to measure the land, and only then could they step away from the matter.
The President said, "Measure it, and if it is within their property, you should give them some time."
To tell the truth, even if they gave us time, we had nowhere else to move that tank.
We only have four cents of land in total. That holds the house, the well, and everything else.
We had absolutely no other place to move it to. They said they would come to measure it the next day.
The next day, they arrived with their workers. But I stood there and prayed earnestly to the Blessed Mother.
I prayed, "Blessed Mother, they are measuring. If the canal stone falls inside their property, I have no other place to move this."
I pleaded, "I only have four cents of land." They measured it thoroughly, stepping back and forth.
Miraculously, my tank stood there as if pushed completely away from their property line.
I am absolutely certain that my Blessed Mother saved me there. Until then, I hadn't told my husband about my prayer.
I hadn't told him that I had submitted a 'light a candle' request. Once this was resolved, I finally told him.
They measured it many times, and they themselves were convinced that the tank was entirely within our property.
It was resting there as if it had been pushed away, not touching their land at all.
After they left, I told my husband everything that happened. I explained how the children and I lit the lamp and submitted the request.
My husband didn't have faith until then. But I told him, "I have to go there and take the Pilgrim Covenant."
And so, on September 17, 2024, I came here and took the Pilgrim Covenant.
On the very day I was supposed to come and take the Pilgrim Covenant, I found out.... This is my husband's closest friend.
I learned that he had cancer. So, when I came here, my very first prayer intention was for him.
He runs a pushcart.  Whenever we needed him, even in the middle of the night, he was there for us.
We used to have a coconut business. My husband would come home from his duty at 7 PM.
At 7 PM, he would take this brother along to pick up coconuts, and they would only return around 1 AM.
He is someone who comes running no matter what time of the night we call him.
To make it worse, they didn't have children for many years and just recently had a baby. That deeply broke my heart.
When I first came here to take the Covenant, my first intention was, "Blessed Mother, you saved me from the irrigation issue."
They said his cancer had started five years ago, located near the eye, and people said he would lose his eye.
I wrote, "He must not lose his eye; the cancer must not spread anywhere else from where it is."
I prayed, "Let it stay right there and be completely healed from there."
I wrote that down, and that very day I went to him and prayed over him, anointing him with the Holy Oil.
After all the surgeries, he had to undergo chemotherapy to make sure it hadn't spread.
He was supposed to have 30 sessions, but the doctor said he didn't have the health or strength to endure it.
But there too, the Blessed Mother saved him, and even the doctors were amazed. The Blessed Mother gave him the strength.
She gave him the good health to endure the chemotherapy. After that, he had to go for various scans to check if it had spread.
When he was going for that, I had a terrible fear. I was terrified if it had spread and what the scan would show.
My heart kept telling me to give him my covenant medal. But Father here had instructed us not to hand over our medal to anyone.
That night, during my evening prayers, I prayed to the Blessed Mother.
I said, "Blessed Mother, he is going for the scan tomorrow, and I really want to give him this medal."
I prayed, "Because if he has this medal in his hand, I have faith that the cancer will not spread."
Before that, I had brought him here, and the priest had performed the laying on of hands over him.
The priest had prayed over him with the laying on of hands. So, I prayed, "If I am to give him this medal,"
"You must give me a sign." They said they were leaving at 10 AM, but even by 9 AM, the Blessed Mother had not given me a sign.
Around 9:15, I went there, stood and prayed, asking, "Mother Mary, I couldn't send it then, could I?".
"Or else you would have given me some sign," and no sooner had I said this, a strong fragrance of jasmine filled the room.
It was such an overwhelming fragrance that one could hardly stand in that room, so I quickly called my husband and said, "Vishwan, run here quickly!".
"There is a beautiful fragrance in the prayer room," but he was downstairs and said, "You go ahead, work is going on upstairs in the study room.".
The work was going on, but the fragrance didn't let him stay there; it reached him all the way, and he quickly came down right behind me.
He said, "Hey, the fragrance reached all the way there," so I said, "The clothes we are wearing are fine, they are about to leave, let's go quickly.".
We quickly got into the vehicle, and just as they were stepping out to leave, I gave him my medal to take along.
I sent it with him, and then I came back and sat there, beginning to intercede for them.
The results came around 1:30, and until I got the results, I sat there and prayed without even a drop of water.
I prayed, "Blessed Mother, I need to hear that the result is negative and that he is completely healed of cancer, only then will I get up from here.".
That is what I said, and I stayed right there; then around 1:30, Vishwan called him.
He told him, "They did so many tests on me, but my cancer is completely cured, and that disease is no longer in me.".
He said it is no longer in him, and that was a huge relief for me because I see him as the elder brother I never had.
That was a very great and profound experience for me; because when I came here the second time to renew my Covenant, the sister asked me.
When renewing my Covenant, the sister asked if I had any testimonies to share, and even then I said I didn't have any for myself.
But I had interceded for two or three other people, though they hadn't come here, so I couldn't share it.
I prayed for all of them and their intentions were fulfilled, and that is what we need the most.
We shouldn't just seek things for ourselves; we must intercede and pray for others, for that is our true calling.
When we do that, Jesus will take care of our needs too, and I experienced this firsthand.
While I was interceding for this brother, for quite some time, my husband hadn't been able to lift his arm upwards.
He needed a lot of physiotherapy, but due to financial difficulties, we didn't pursue any of those treatments.
It required money, but I kept thinking, "Why worry?" so I applied the Holy Oil and prayed, telling the Blessed Mother every day.
I would say, "Blessed Mother, I will come before you and testify; my husband used to chop wood and do everything himself."
But he couldn't lift his arm to chop wood, so we ended up having to hire someone to do it.
However, as a result of anointing him with the Holy Oil and interceding, today my husband can lift his arm perfectly well.
He can lift it well and do all those chores now; that was one of the greatest blessings I received.
Then, recently, my husband came down with a severe fever; the fever spiked dangerously high.
When we ran tests, the results showed that he had jaundice, which put me in deep distress.
I asked the Blessed Mother, "The moment he wakes up in the morning, he is the one who consumes the Blessed Salt and Holy Oil even more diligently than we do."
I cried, "And is he the one you allowed to get jaundice, Blessed Mother?"
Before going to the hospital, I prayed with the Blessed Salt and Holy Oil, and I recited the Apostles' Creed.
I gave it to him and said to her, "Blessed Mother, if they order another test today, this jaundice must not show up in it."
I promised, "When I give my testimony at the altar, I will share this miracle as well," and thus, we went to see the doctor.
The doctor said we needed to do one more test to confirm what it was, since the previous one showed jaundice.
He ordered another blood test, but when we received the results of that test, there was no trace of jaundice.
When we showed that result to the doctor, he asked, "Who told you that you had jaundice?"
He declared, "There is absolutely no jaundice in this," and that was another massive blessing for me.
Regarding our property documents, we had mortgaged our documents for the construction of our house.
We were managing it with just one person's salary, and the loan was for 12 years; now six years had passed.
When I came here to renew my Covenant, I had placed an intention in my Covenant to retrieve my property documents.
I had submitted it, but then I completely forgot about it, until we casually checked the passbook recently.
In these six years, out of the three lakhs we took, we had paid back two lakhs.
But when we contacted the bank, they said all of that had gone towards the interest.
They said, "Only in the remaining six years will your principal amount be reduced," meaning all six years of payments were just interest.
I was shocked and asked Vishwan, "How are we going to manage paying this for another six years?"
I pleaded with the Blessed Mother, "Mother, please help us pay off that amount before the term ends."
"With our children's education and everything, we are struggling; please help us retrieve our documents somehow."
I said this, and every day at 5:30, we would join the priest's daily bread prayer.
I would hold that bank passbook in my hands and pray fervently during that time.
During the priest's prayer with the Holy Cross, I would hold the passbook and intercede to get my documents back as soon as possible.
Miraculously, within a week, with the help of a friend and by pledging some gold, things worked out.
A friend helped us immensely; I am not revealing his name because he asked me not to.
With that friend's help, I got my property documents back in my hands.
It was a document we were told we would never get back this soon.
Because the Blessed Mother interceded with Jesus during the priest's Daily Bread prayer, we have that document in our hands today.
My only prayer is that God showers continuous blessings on that great man and his family who helped us retrieve it.
He extends so much help not just to us, but to many people in that area.
Also, regarding my own health, I had suffered from severe migraines since my childhood.
When a migraine hit, I couldn't bear to see light, and it would be accompanied by terrible vomiting.
I never brought my own issues before the Blessed Mother; they had even recommended surgery for my hand because a nerve was compressed here.
I never placed an intention for it; until today, I have never placed a single intention for my own needs.
I only ever placed intentions for my husband or for others, but because of the pain in both my hands, my husband and children suffered.
My children had to do most of the chores, like washing the clothes and sweeping the yard.
I don't know how it happened, but I would apply the Blessed Salt and Holy Oil and pray every day.
After coming here, my severe migraines completely vanished.
Similarly, I could never travel in state transport buses; if I boarded one, I would throw up immediately.
Not just buses, I couldn't go on any long journeys without vomiting, but today I have no such sickness and no migraines.
Today, I can do anything with this hand that was supposed to have surgery; I have absolutely no pain.
Many people in our hometown had undergone this surgery, and they said the pain persists even after surgery.
But the Blessed Mother spared me from that fate and took away the ailment completely before it came to that.
What I want to share next is my apostolic work; I buy the Kreupasanam paper and distribute it in hospitals.
We also distribute food packets, and whenever we hear of sick people in our area, we visit them.
We help them according to what we have in our hands.
Moreover, whoever crosses my path, even if they refuse to listen, I proclaim all the blessings my Blessed Mother has given me.
My son also received healing, but since he is not here, I am not detailing it; my mother also received healing.
The Blessed Mother will bless me to bring my mother and my son here together in the month of May.
I will come here in the month of May, because I am certain that my Mother Mary will grant me those blessings,
so when I come back on that day as a testimony, I will share those experiences, and I pray that God always grants me and my family,
the heart to continue doing everything like this for others,
and with millions of thanks to my Mother Mary and the Holy Son for giving me all these profound blessings, I am concluding my testimony.
In the Book of Exodus, chapter 19, verse 5, the Word of God says,
"Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice and keep my Covenant,
you shall be my treasured possession among all peoples, for all the earth is mine."
This is the very powerful and heartfelt testimony of revelation declared by this daughter, Sister Radhika Rajan,
who has come here today along with her life partner,
and friend to proclaim this great testimony to the apparition at the altar.
She is expressing profound gratitude for the blessings, graces,
and the Anointing received from Jesus through the powerful Intercession of the Blessed Mother in their lives.
Radhika Rajan's first testimony is about how the Blessed Mother powerfully advocated for them as a wonderful defender in a land dispute,
securing justice from Jesus for their family against the Irrigation Department.
As we know, no matter how deep our sorrows are or how hostile our circumstances become,
the Blessed Mother always takes a firm stand for us.

She also testified about an Intercession prayer she offered for her husband's friend.
When this beloved son was enduring immense agony due to cancer,
the grace this daughter received was the answered prayer to Jesus, pleading for that son's healing through Intercession.
That powerful prayer was so miraculously answered, that they received a report from the hospital confirming his cancer was completely negative.
This is a tremendous testimony, and as St. Peter's life shows, this daughter did not pray for herself at all.
Radhika Rajan says, "Even during my vomiting and my headaches, I never wrote down a prayer intention for myself,"
"but only prayed that my husband should be able to lift his hand, his hand pain should be healed, and our friend should receive miraculous healing."
She testifies that when she interceded for all these things, mighty miracles took place in her own life.
During the Transfiguration of Jesus on Mount Tabor, St. Peter, forgetting everything else, says,
"I will make three tents here, one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah."
Peter had no anxious thoughts about where he himself would live,
because he possessed the profound faith and absolute certainty that he was always dwelling in the tent of God. He had the divine grace to stand united with God,
and similarly, through Father Joseph's blessing during the Daily Bread, this daughter testifies that a great settlement was miraculously achieved regarding their house deed.
For six long years, they had been paying heavy interest, and they were told they would only get their house deed back if they kept paying for another six years.
But in that desperate situation, Jesus blessed them miraculously....
A brother had helped them by giving more than a lakh rupees, and when they renewed their Covenant today, they experienced a mighty miracle.
After the Covenant renewal, they received the great news that the money the brother gave them as a loan was now a free gift,
and they no longer needed to repay it.
